title: NSGo game editor MCP permissions (version 1)
description:
PermissionsFile is the versioned YAML document stored in permissions.yaml beside game.yaml. Rules are evaluated from top to bottom and the first matching rule decides. A file looks like this:

# yaml-language-server: $schema=https://game.nsgo.dev/schemas/permissions.v1.json version: 1 profile: balanced rules: - action: edit patterns: - scenes/** - prefabs/** - data/** decision: allow

version.description: Version is the schema version; it must equal PermissionsVersion (1).

profile.description: Profile names the base preset ("cautious", "balanced", or "autonomous"). Editing individual rules keeps Profile so the editor can mark the profile as changed from its preset.

rules.description: Rules is the ordered first-match-wins permission table checked before every mutating or running MCP tool call.

PermissionRule.description: PermissionRule is one row in the first-match-wins permission rule table.

action.description: Action is the kind of operation this rule matches ("edit", "create", "delete", "run", or "code").

patterns.description: Patterns lists slash-separated file globs (such as "scenes/**", "game.yaml", "**/*.go", "**") or run targets (such as "game check", "playtests", "shell").

decision.description: Decision is what happens when this rule is the first match ("allow", "ask", or "deny").
